newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Central & South West Corp's CP programme.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Central & South West Corp's CP programme.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it has assigned its A2 rating to Central & South West Corp's commercial paper programme.
S&P said the paper was backed by a $800 million five-year and a $400 million 364-day bank agreement led by Morgan Guaranty Trust.
Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch are the commercial paper dealers, S&P said in a statement.
"The rating reflects the creditworthiness of the consolidated company, which is judged to be an A minus credit," S&P said.

S&P said credit strength is derived from U.S. operating subsidiaries Central Power & Light Co (A senior secured debt), Public Service Co of Oklahoma (A plus senior secured debt), West Texas Utilities Inc (A plus senior secured debt), and Southwestern Electric Power Co. (AA minus senior secured debt).
"These ratings, however, carry negative outlooks, and will likely be lowered one notch to reflect the impact of regulatory actions in Texas and Oklahoma," S&P said.
